section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study of 228 undergraduate Black female students at a large, urban Mid-Atlantic university (M age = 19.89, SD = 4.57; mean BMI = 24.71, SD = 6.04). Data were collected online via SONA Systems and participants were recruited from a Psychology 101 participant pool and other psychology courses. The section does not report any body appreciation (BA) measure or correlations between BA and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants were 228 undergraduate Black female college students (M age = 19.89, SD = 4.57) at a large, urban university in the Mid-Atlantic. Mean BMI was 24.71 (SD = 6.04). Measures were administered through a secure website called SONA Systems, an online data collection program maintained by the university. Participants were recruited from a Psychology 101 Participant Pool, as well as other psychology courses.
